technical_fidelity.evidence: Every Methods statement was traced to a specific function, source anchor, protocol or immutable run artifact in the M7.3, public-pipeline, M7.4 and M7.5 packages; METH-29 through METH-39 record the system, sheaf-versus-graph and robust/hybrid evidence.

main_supplement_split.evidence: Main Methods retains the linked design, primary fusion and affine-section equations, and M7.4/M7.5 claim rules; detailed public-pipeline stages, competence matching, two-stage locks, LOO weighting, group cross-fitting and both calibration regimes are in Supplementary Methods.

expert_clarity.evidence: Both sections were re-read for logical paragraph flow (what was done, on what material, with which parameter, how validated) and for consistency of terminology (evidence panel names H/A/C, topology conditions, tracer regimes) across Main and Supplementary Methods.

passive_nonpersonal.evidence: Both sections were drafted and re-read in past-tense, passive, non-personal construction; the automated first-person-pronoun scan in methods_gate_check.py draft stage was used as a supporting check.

uk_english.evidence: UK spelling was applied throughout (e.g. 'standardised', 'characterised', 'programme' where applicable) and checked by manual re-read of both Methods documents.

reporting_guideline_coverage.evidence: The two applicable official-documentation standards (MODFLOW 6/MODPATH 7 simulation documentation; PHREEQC speciation/reaction documentation) were identified as the discipline-appropriate analogue to a clinical reporting guideline and are cited at first use of each corresponding procedure.

equation_accuracy.evidence: EQ-1 through EQ-6 were retained from the verified M7.3 implementation; EQ-7 was checked term-by-term against hydrosheaf/sheaf/directed_section.py and the matched graph/sheaf runner, including identity-map specialisation.

reproducibility.evidence: Software, seeds, particle/bootstrap counts, identity tolerances, model budgets and exclusions were checked against the M7.3 manifest, RUN-M7-SYSTEM-20260728-01, RUN-M7-SHEAF-VS-GRAPH-20260729-01, the two-stage RUN-M7-ROBUST-HYBRID-SHEAF-20260729-01 locks, and README regeneration instructions.
